# Pilot scope {.unnumbered}

This candidate edition reformats only the opening of **Linear dynamics and
exact-capture comparisons**, through its original Section 4. It is a publishing
pilot, not a new scientific result or a replacement for the maintained book.

The chapter's order, mathematical content and heading hierarchy are preserved.
Displayed section, theorem and equation numbers are generated automatically and
can differ from the original. The source mapping retains the original identities.

Two introductory references, **Sections 1–7** and **Sections 8–12**, extend beyond
this excerpt and remain explicitly pending. The original **NOTATION.md** is
supplied as a resource, not claimed as migrated content. No bibliography entries
occur in this excerpt. The previous artificial fixture separately tests citations.
